title: Introduce knowledge-base ingestion, document repository, indexing job, and vector persistence boundaries
description: TASK-031 added KB document, parser, chunking, retrieval, vector-store, and formatter ports, but AstrBot also has KB manager, SQLite KB metadata, helper/indexing orchestration, parser fan-out, and FAISS document/vector persistence. Rust needs an ingestion/index job boundary before dashboard KB CRUD or agent KB context wiring grows.

files.change: Define document repository, media store, ingestion request/progress, indexing job, and vector persistence ports outside retrieval.
Keep agent request decoration consuming formatted KB context rather than owning ingestion or vector persistence.

criteria: Parsing/chunking/embedding/vector upsert orchestration is separate from retrieval queries.
KB metadata/document repository ports are testable without dashboard routes or runtime assembly.
Agent integration receives formatted retrieval context through a port.
convergence.verification_command: cargo test -p astrbot-kb && cargo test -p astrbot-storage && cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings
